Sentence (English): First of all, I would like to say that I already had a 12-year-old dishwasher and although it was also spacious, now I realize how necessary it was for me to change to a better category one, since with this the cutlery comes out dry and without traces of limescale and I don't have to be passing a cloth to make them shiny.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher with many washing options! ] || ---------------- || First of all, I would like to say that I already had a 12-year-old dishwasher and although it was also spacious, now I realize how necessary it was for me to change to a better category one, since with this the cutlery comes out dry and without traces of limescale and I don't have to be passing a cloth to make them shiny. The first moment you open it and start it up, you can see that it is a quality appliance, all its materials feel strong. The first program that I used as soon as I installed it was ECO, since I was in a bit of a hurry and I was amazed with the results in such a short time, including even pots with somewhat encrusted tomato. The same for another type of washing with more encrusted grease, I would use another program, which uses only a little more water and time but still, it beats any dishwasher I have had at home, it is really wonderful not having to dry the pots because drops of water remain or even because they come out wet, in this case it does not happen since it has a lot of removable trays to be able to order all the cutlery, plates, pots and trays that you want to place to wash and they remain very organized so that they can wash well on all surfaces. I really liked the acoustic sound that it emits at the end of any type of washing since you are cleaning the house and it alerts you so you don't have to be looking if it has finished or not, to be able to place all the pots and pans on the furniture. It also has a very useful mobile App called LG ThinQ that shows you a lot of information about the wash. I am super happy with this purchase since it has completely changed my way of using dishwashers, I repeat again, that of not having to dry each pot that you put in or each cutlery that you put in. It saves me a lot of time a day since we are 5 in the family and we use it a lot.
Comments (Original): [ Lavavajillas con muchas opciones de lavado! ] || ---------------- || Antes de nada decir que tenia ya un lavavajillas de 12 años y aunque también era amplio ahora me doy cuenta de la falta que me hacía cambiar a uno de mejor categoría ya que con este los cubiertos salen secos y sin restos de cal y no tengo que estar pasándole un trapo para que queden brillantes. En el primer momento que lo abres y lo pones en funcionamiento ya ves que es un electrodoméstico de calidad, todos sus materiales se sienten fuertes. El primer programa que usé nada más instalarlo fue el ECO ya que tenia un poco de prisa y aluciné con los resultados en tan poco tiempo, metiendo incluso hasta ollas con tomate algo incrustado. Igual para otro tipo de lavado con grasa más incrustada usaría otro programa, que gasta solamente un poquito más de agua y tiempo pero aún así, le gana a cualquier lavavajillas que haya tenido en casa, es realmente una maravilla no tener que estar secando los cacharros porque se queden gotas de agua o incluso porque salgan mojados, en este caso no pasa ya que tiene un montón de bandejas extraibles para poder ordenar todos los cubiertos, platos, ollas y bandejas que quieras colocar a lavar y se quedan muy organizados para que puedan lavarse bien en todas sus superficies. Me gustó mucho el sonido acústico que emite al finalizar cualquier tipo de lavado ya que estás limpiando la casa y te avisa para que no tengas que estar mirando si ha terminado o no, para poder colocar todos los cacharros en los muebles. Comments (English): [ Comfortable and good #dishwasher #dishwasher for 6 people #dishwasher recommendation ] || ---------------- || Product name: Media Dishwasher Power consumption: 1170W Capacity: For 6 people Product size: 550500438mm Product weight: 21.5kg Installer visited. I wanted a dishwasher! I'm busy and washing dishes is the most annoying thing than laundry and cleaning. My parents have a built-in dishwasher, but they don't use it much, so they bought a separate, smaller one and use it often. My house is too small for a built-in one and I'm planning on moving, so I decided to choose a 6-person dishwasher. It was quick to install thanks to Coupang Rocket Delivery. ^^ It was scheduled for delivery two days after I ordered, and the installer called me the day before to coordinate the time. He called me on the day of installation as well. He placed it in the desired location and attached the drain hose using a special bubble wrap. The pipe connecting to the water inlet is connected by drilling a small hole, but after reading other reviews, I asked to use a water purifier hose ^^ * I changed it to a slim hose by connecting it to a dedicated valve (additional 4,000 won). * It's 4,000 won of happiness. It looks much neater! The hole is easily drilled quickly and the drilling sound is not loud. (Even the neighbors don't know.) It was installed quickly and simply, so I was able to finish it quickly. I asked how to collect it when I move, and they said it was easy because I just had to close the valve and cut the line! They said the valve connecting the water supply costs about 10,000 won. They kindly explained my questions and completed the installation well. They turned on the power to check if it was working properly and collected the box I brought. The installation took about 30-40 minutes. If you look at the manual, it seems that it can be used without difficulty. There are 7 program icons in the control section description: [Strong, Standard, Eco, Glass, 90 minutes, Quick, Automatic Cleaning]. You can choose the mode you want. The detailed description of the washing course includes the cycle order, detergent amount, operating time, power consumption, water used, and whether or not there is a rinse aid for each program. There is also a description of the dishwasher arrangement in the manual, so it is not difficult to use. <Review> I bought and used a dishwasher-specific detergent! Since the amount of dishes was not much, I tried the P6 quick mode. You can change the mode by pressing the P button, and the quick mode takes 30 minutes and the remaining time is displayed next to the P button. P6 washes at a water temperature of 55 degrees. You can hear the sound of water being supplied through the inlet, and the noise is much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The operating sound is about the same as the sound of water trickling from a faucet turned on. I am very satisfied because it is quieter than I thought! It is enough that it does not bother me at all even when the baby is sleeping. There is a humming sound when draining, but it is about the same noise as a dryer. It is not noisy. When the dishes are finished, it beeps about 8 times. As other people have reviewed, the only regret is that there is no automatic door opening function. But I can open it and adjust the angle of the door as I like, so it's not that inconvenient. P7 mode takes 10 minutes longer than quick mode because the water temperature is 70 degrees, so it can deodorize and dry with the residual heat. It's hotter when I open the door, and the inside dries quickly even if I open it slightly. When it's done and I open it, the dishes are squeaky clean, and there are no water stains on the water cup, which is nice. It's even more special because it says it uses water sparingly. It's quite tall, so you can stack it on top so that it doesn't overlap in two tiers, and it's okay to put a tumbler or pot in it. I like that I have more time because I'm freed from washing dishes~ ! I'm satisfied with the dishwasher ^^ Good, good! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I wanted a dishwasher! I'm busy and washing dishes is the most annoying thing than laundry and cleaning. My parents have a built-in dishwasher, but they don't use it much, so they bought a separate, smaller one and use it often. My house is too small for a built-in one and I'm planning on moving, so I decided to choose a 6-person dishwasher. It was quick to install thanks to Coupang Rocket Delivery. ^^ It was scheduled for delivery two days after I ordered, and the installer called me the day before to coordinate the time. He called me on the day of installation as well. He placed it in the desired location and attached the drain hose using a special bubble wrap. The pipe connecting to the water inlet is connected by drilling a small hole, but after reading other reviews, I asked to use a water purifier hose ^^ * I changed it to a slim hose by connecting it to a dedicated valve (additional 4,000 won). * It's 4,000 won of happiness. It looks much neater! The hole is easily drilled quickly and the drilling sound is not loud. (Even the neighbors don't know.) It was installed quickly and simply, so I was able to finish it quickly. I asked how to collect it when I move, and they said it was easy because I just had to close the valve and cut the line! They said the valve connecting the water supply costs about 10,000 won. They kindly explained my questions and completed the installation well. They turned on the power to check if it was working properly and collected the box I brought. The installation took about 30-40 minutes. If you look at the manual, it seems that it can be used without difficulty. There are 7 program icons in the control section description: [Strong, Standard, Eco, Glass, 90 minutes, Quick, Automatic Cleaning]. You can choose the mode you want. The detailed description of the washing course includes the cycle order, detergent amount, operating time, power consumption, water used, and whether or not there is a rinse aid for each program. There is also a description of the dishwasher arrangement in the manual, so it is not difficult to use. <Review> I bought and used a dishwasher-specific detergent! Since the amount of dishes was not much, I tried the P6 quick mode. You can change the mode by pressing the P button, and the quick mode takes 30 minutes and the remaining time is displayed next to the P button. P6 washes at a water temperature of 55 degrees. You can hear the sound of water being supplied through the inlet, and the noise is much quieter than a washing machine or dryer. The operating sound is about the same as the sound of water trickling from a faucet turned on. I am very satisfied because it is quieter than I thought! It is enough that it does not bother me at all even when the baby is sleeping. There is a humming sound when draining, but it is about the same noise as a dryer. It is not noisy. When the dishes are finished, it beeps about 8 times. As other people have reviewed, the only regret is that there is no automatic door opening function. But I can open it and adjust the angle of the door as I like, so it's not that inconvenient. P7 mode takes 10 minutes longer than quick mode because the water temperature is 70 degrees, so it can deodorize and dry with the residual heat. It's hotter when I open the door, and the inside dries quickly even if I open it slightly. When it's done and I open it, the dishes are squeaky clean, and there are no water stains on the water cup, which is nice. It's even more special because it says it uses water sparingly. It's quite tall, so you can stack it on top so that it doesn't overlap in two tiers, and it's okay to put a tumbler or pot in it. I like that I have more time because I'm freed from washing dishes~ ! I'm satisfied with the dishwasher ^^ Good, good! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I recently moved and threw away my old dishwasher, so I've been hand-washing dishes for about a month.
Comments (English): [ Of course, you can't live without a dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I recently moved and threw away my old dishwasher, so I've been hand-washing dishes for about a month. Man, I didn't realize it when I did it occasionally, but hand-washing dishes every time is no easy feat. When it came to buying a new dishwasher, I was hesitant to buy Samsung because of ODM issues (they say they're producing this year's batch directly, but I'll have to wait and see). I agonized over SK and LG for a while. It turns out my dishwasher has always been SK. But in the end, I decided on LG Objet because I always said LG is the best for white goods! My recently purchased washing machines are connected to LG ThinQ, which has had a significant impact. Whether it's a washing machine or a dishwasher, checking the full-cleaning cycle is surprisingly helpful. Anyway, I passed on the lowest-end EP model because it lacks Wi-Fi and lacks soundproofing. I was debating between the 1 Series and the 4 Series, but the only differences are the location of the display buttons and the presence of steam and hot air functions, but everything else is the same. Sterilization is more than sufficient as long as the temperature exceeds 80 degrees Celsius. Even if it had a steam function, it would probably only run on standard or automatic. The hot air drying feature is a bit fluffier, but the water pooling issue is largely a function of the bowl shape and water hardness, so it's not really a big deal. I've been using a dishwasher for over 15 years, and I'm a mid-level housewife who hasn't needed anything other than standard or quick washes. They said next-day installation would be available if ordered before 4 p.m., so I hurriedly ordered after lunch yesterday, and the technician arrived around lunchtime today. It's right next to the sink, and it's a standard cabinet, so installation conditions were ideal, but he installed it alone for about an hour. I thought it would have been really, really difficult if the conditions were more challenging. The installation was very thorough and neat. He didn't need to explain everything, but he did. After finishing the installation and running a test wash, I immediately ordered salt from Coupang and am leaving this review. I prefer neutral colors, so I'll pass on the green one. It's a neutral beige, neither too white nor too yellow. It goes well with my dark-toned kitchen. People who have never used a dishwasher can never live without it, but people who have used one can never live without it. It protects my neck, shoulders, and back, saves time, saves water, protects my hands, skin, and respiratory system. It is truly an investment for me. I use the three sacred household appliances: a robot vacuum cleaner, a dishwasher, and a dryer, but the dishwasher is by far the best for my physical and mental health! I really enjoyed it. Bottom line! If you have a baby at home and want to use the steam function, or you are not yet familiar with dishwashers and just want to try the highest spec model, then the 4 series will do. (Or if you like the dark green color, then the 4 series.) If you want a cost-effective item with almost no functional difference from the 4 series, you can save 400,000 won by getting the 1 series.

After finishing the installation and running a test wash, I immediately ordered salt from Coupang and am leaving this review. I prefer neutral colors, so I'll pass on the green one. Sentence (English): Here is a heads up Costco Members.
Comments (English): [ Careful… Concierge Service Is Not What Is Expectef ] || ---------------- || Here is a heads up Costco Members. I bought this dishwasher and had it installed. So far no problems with the dishwasher. Costco website states that Costco will deliver and take away old dishwasher. The dishwasher was delivered and the driver told me that when the appliance company comes to disconnect and install, they will return to pick up the old dishwasher. Driver told me to call Costco Concierge. I called Costco concierge today and they told me it had to be disconnected and ready for pick up the same day of delivery. If I want it picked up now, the cost is $135.00. I explained to the Costco concierge man that if I was to accomplish that, the truck would have had to arrive exactly at 2:00, he disconnects exactly the time the dishwasher arrives to put new one in. 1. The Costco delivery time and date changed twice. 2. Appliance guys are hard to pin down to delivery time 3. Costco's rule, I would need two service calls. Cost concierge told me that other people manage this so it should not be a problem for me. Careful with what you think the rules are because concierge told me the driver was wrong. It's on their website. $135.00 is the price for removal if you cannot do everything all at once.
